thread:
jess_procure: FYI vendor Aurora flagged possible condensation damage on ocean leg to FRA. AWB: 770-5550011. Manifest says 48 H200s, vendor reporting 12 with moisture stains on inner foam. Need RMA path + whether to accept depot rework or require replacements.

aurora_tech: Uploaded photos + humidity log to claim tracker: https://shipments.example/claim/7705550011. Condensation seems localized to 2 pallets (12 units). Pallet wrap breached. We recommend depot drying + connector inspection; repair cost estimate EUR 800/unit.

lee_logistics: Can FRA depot do drying/inspection or is it better to repatriate? How long to rework 12 units?

aurora_tech: Depot estimate: 48-72h to inspect and test; repalletize cost EUR 600 + diagnostics EUR 120/unit. Repair (if needed) extra.

omar_ops: We can't afford losing 12 H200s—next week's Dedicated rollout needs 10. Tara, what's the threshold for approving depot repair versus calling replacements from vendor reserve?

tara_finance: Financial threshold is EUR 2,000 per unit (total landed cost incl. freight & duty). If depot fix + logistics < EUR 2,000, approve. Otherwise request replacements or credit.

jess_procure: Aurora—can you offer provisional credit for any units that fail post-depot test? Also what's your lead time to ship replacements from your EU reserve if we opt replacement?

aurora_tech: We can put provisional credit for up to 12 units pending depot test: proforma REF-AUR-221. EU reserve SLA: air replacement ETA 96h after confirmation (subject to carrier). We can also repalletize and forward undamaged units now.

shipping_bot: AWB 770-5550011 status: Customs CLEARED - FRA HUB at 2025-11-04T07:12:00Z. Current location FRA Main Hub.

lee_logistics: Proposal: split off 36 undamaged units for immediate forward to NL provisioning (track NL-APAC wave), hold 12 at FRA depot for inspection. Splitting cost estimate EUR 520 (one-time). If Aurora provides provisional credit, I recommend split to keep provisioning on track.

omar_ops: Approve split conditional on provisional credit and written depot inspection slot. Lee, book inspection and hold slot for tomorrow 14:00 CET. Jess, get Aurora to sign provisional credit doc.

jess_procure: On it. Aurora, please email signed proforma and attach proof of insurance acceptance for the damaged units.

aurora_tech: Sent email with REF-AUR-221 signed, insurance acceptance attached. Carrier will reconsign 36 units to AMS within 24h after split approval.

tara_finance: I'll pre-authorize the depot spend up to EUR 1,800 per unit while we wait for final test results; any overage requires escalation. Please capture invoices/scans.

ops_bot: Action items created: [A-942] Lee to confirm depot inspection result; [A-943] Jess to validate provisional credit; [A-944] Aurora to schedule reconsign.

lee_logistics: Booked depot slot 2025-11-04 14:00 CET. Depot contact +49-69-222-3344. I'll upload inspection notes when done.

omar_ops: Also queue 6 temporary loaner H200s from our cross-region pool to cover two Dedicated pools for 72h in case any repairs take longer. Kevin_supply will handle allocation.

jess_procure: Thanks. Closing for now until depot result.

aurora_tech: We'll standby and expedite replacements if depot fails >4 units.

shipping_bot: Update: Split release authorized pending depot confirmation. New AWB for reconsigned 36 units: 770-5550022.
